translations.EN: That's a lot of them. Stay sharp.
translations.TL: Ang dami nila. Mag-ingat tayo.

translations.EN: We've got a whole crowd moving in. Eyes open.
translations.TL: May malaking grupo na paparating. Magmatyag.

translations.EN: Horde spotted! Check your exits.
translations.TL: May kuyog! Tignan ang mga labasan.

translations.EN: Too many bodies out there. Watch the perimeter.
translations.TL: Masyado silang marami sa labas. Bantayan ang paligid.

translations.EN: They're grouping up. Form a line.
translations.TL: Nagsasama-sama sila. Ayusin ang hanay.

translations.EN: Sound drew a swarm. Get ready.
translations.TL: Nakaakit ng kuyog ang ingay. Humanda.

translations.EN: Look at that herd. Stay close.
translations.TL: Tingnan mo ang kawan na 'yan. Dumikit ka.

translations.EN: Mass contacts coming from down the street.
translations.TL: Napakaraming papalapit mula sa kalsada.

translations.EN: Here they come. Don't let them flank us.
translations.TL: Heto na sila. Huwag silang hayaang pumaligid.

translations.EN: Big group incoming. Watch each other's backs.
translations.TL: Malaking grupo ang dumarating. Bantayan ang likod ng bawat isa.

translations.EN: More are piling in. This is getting bad.
translations.TL: Dumarami sila. Lumalala ito.

translations.EN: They keep coming! We're losing ground.
translations.TL: Patuloy silang dumarami! Nawawalan tayo ng espasyo.

translations.EN: The herd just doubled. We need a plan.
translations.TL: Doble na ang dami nila. Kailangan natin ng plano.

translations.EN: Too many to push through! Fall back a step.
translations.TL: Masyadong marami para lusubin! Umatras nang kaunti.

translations.EN: The swarm's thickening. Watch your flanks!
translations.TL: Kumakapal ang kuyog. Bantayan ang gilid mo!

translations.EN: Every window is shaking. They're surrounding us.
translations.TL: Nanginginig ang bawat bintana. Pinalilibutan nila tayo.

translations.EN: They're pouring through the gaps. Steady!
translations.TL: Bumubuhos sila sa mga butas. Magpakatatag!

translations.EN: This isn't thinning out, it's growing!
translations.TL: Hindi sila kumokonti, lalo pang dumarami!

translations.EN: More rottens behind the first wave!
translations.TL: May mga bulok pa sa likod ng unang grupo!

translations.EN: We're getting boxed in. Don't stop swinging.
translations.TL: Naiipit na tayo. Huwag titigil sa paghataw.

translations.EN: They're thinning out. Don't relax yet.
translations.TL: Kumokonti sila. Huwag munang kampante.

translations.EN: Most of the swarm is down. Check stragglers.
translations.TL: Bagsak na karamihan sa kuyog. Tignan ang mga naiwan.

translations.EN: The main wave is broken. Keep scanning.
translations.TL: Nawasak na ang bulto. Tuloy sa pagmamasid.

translations.EN: Fewer coming through now. Catch your breath.
translations.TL: Kakaunti na lang ang dumarating. Huminga muna.

translations.EN: Herd's scattered. Clear the remaining few.
translations.TL: Kalat na ang kuyog. Ubusin ang natitira.

translations.EN: We weathered the bulk of them. Stay focused.
translations.TL: Nalagpasan natin ang pinakamarami. Manatiling nakatutok.

translations.EN: Numbers are dropping. Keep the pressure on.
translations.TL: Bumaba na ang bilang nila. Tuloy ang laban.

translations.EN: They're losing momentum. Finish them off.
translations.TL: Nawawalan na sila ng pwersa. Tapusin na natin sila.

translations.EN: Only a handful left. Watch your spacing.
translations.TL: Ilan-ilan na lang ang natitira. Bantayan ang distansya.

translations.EN: The rush is slowing down. Good work.
translations.TL: Bumagal na ang pagdagsa. Maganda ang ginawa natin.

translations.EN: Horde nearby. Keep your eyes up.
translations.TL: May kuyog na malapit. Magmatyag tayo.

translations.EN: Large group in the vicinity. Tread quietly.
translations.TL: Malaking grupo sa paligid. Huwag gumawa ng ingay.

translations.EN: There's a swarm around here. Stay cautious.
translations.TL: May kuyog sa lugar na 'to. Mag-ingat.

translations.EN: I hear heavy movement outside. Watch yourself.
translations.TL: May naririnig akong maraming yabag sa labas. Mag-ingat.

translations.EN: Pack of infected close by. Stay alert.
translations.TL: Grupo ng infected malapit dito. Maging alerto.

translations.EN: We're near a wandering horde. Keep low.
translations.TL: Malapit tayo sa palakad-lakad na kuyog. Yumuko.

translations.EN: Too much shuffling out there. Keep weapons ready.
translations.TL: Masyadong maraming kaluskos sa labas. Ihanda ang sandata.

translations.EN: Dead are gathering nearby. Stay on your toes.
translations.TL: Nagtitipon ang mga patay malapit dito. Maging handa.

translations.EN: Horde in the area. Pick your steps carefully.
translations.TL: May kuyog sa paligid. Piliin nang maigi ang bawat hakbang.

translations.EN: Infected swarm close. Don't make unnecessary noise.
translations.TL: Malapit ang kuyog ng infected. Huwag gumawa ng ingay.

translations.EN: That's a hell of a crowd. We taking them?
translations.TL: Ang dami nila. Susugod ba tayo?

translations.EN: Big group ahead. Let's carve right through them.
translations.TL: Malaking grupo sa unahan. Biyakin na natin sila.

translations.EN: Look at all those targets. You ready to swing?
translations.TL: Tingnan mo ang dami ng target. Handa ka na bang humataw?

translations.EN: We can take this pack. What's the call?
translations.TL: Kaya natin ang grupong 'to. Ano'ng desisyon?

translations.EN: I say we clear them out right here. Ready?
translations.TL: Linisin na natin sila rito mismo. Handa ka na?

translations.EN: They're packed together nicely. Time to strike.
translations.TL: Magkakadikit sila nang maayos. Oras na para sumugod.

translations.EN: I've got plenty of energy. Let's drop them.
translations.TL: Marami pa akong lakas. Itumba na natin sila.

translations.EN: Crowd of dead ahead. Give the word and I charge.
translations.TL: Kuyog ng mga patay sa unahan. Sabihin mo lang at susugod ako.

translations.EN: We've got weapons and room. Let's do this.
translations.TL: May sandata at espasyo tayo. Labanan na natin.

translations.EN: Let's crack some skulls. We fighting or what?
translations.TL: Magbasag tayo ng bungo. Lalaban ba tayo o ano?

translations.EN: God... that's a lot. Are we really fighting all of them?
translations.TL: Diyos ko... ang dami nila. Lalabanan talaga natin lahat 'yan?

translations.EN: Look at the size of that crowd... can we go around?
translations.TL: Tingnan mo ang laki ng kuyog... pwede ba tayong umikot?

translations.EN: They'll swarm us if we step out there. Please, let's retreat.
translations.TL: Kukuyugin nila tayo kapag lumabas tayo. Pakiusap, umatras tayo.

translations.EN: There are way too many... my hands are shaking.
translations.TL: Masyado silang marami... nanginginig ang mga kamay ko.

translations.EN: We can't handle this many at once. Can we slip away?
translations.TL: Hindi natin kaya ang ganyan karami nang sabay. Pwede bang tumakas?

translations.EN: Jesus, don't shoot... they'll tear us apart.
translations.TL: Diyos ko, huwag kang puputok... pupunitin nila tayo.

translations.EN: Are we seriously thinking of fighting that horde?
translations.TL: Seryoso ba tayong lalabanan ang kuyog na 'yan?

translations.EN: I don't think we survive that fight. Let's run.
translations.TL: Sa tingin ko hindi tayo mabubuhay sa laban na 'yan. Tumakbo na tayo.

translations.EN: Too many rottens... what do you want to do?
translations.TL: Masyadong maraming bulok... ano'ng gusto mong gawin?

translations.EN: That swarm is terrifying. Tell me we're bypassing it.
translations.TL: Nakakatakot ang kuyog na 'yan. Sabihin mong iiwasan natin.

translations.EN: Horde ahead. Engage or go around?
translations.TL: May kuyog sa unahan. Lalaban o iiwas?

translations.EN: Crowd spotted. Call it.
translations.TL: May nakitang grupo. Desisyunan mo.

translations.EN: Massed dead. Fight or bypass?
translations.TL: Nagtitipong mga patay. Lalabanan o lalagpasan?

translations.EN: Swarm blocking route. Your call.
translations.TL: Harang ang kuyog sa daan. Ikaw ang masusunod.

translations.EN: Large group. Stand and fight or slip past?
translations.TL: Malaking grupo. Tatayo at lalaban o lulusot?

translations.EN: Herd ahead. Make a choice.
translations.TL: Kawan sa harap. Pumili ka.

translations.EN: Horde present. Direct us.
translations.TL: May kuyog dito. Pangunahan mo kami.

translations.EN: Too many in the open. Do we push or turn?
translations.TL: Masyadong marami sa bukas na lugar. Susulong o liliko?

translations.EN: Mass contacts. Decision?
translations.TL: Maraming kalaban. Ano'ng pasya?

translations.EN: Herd in path. Fight or avoid?
translations.TL: May kuyog sa dinaraanan. Laban o iwas?

translations.EN: That's a lot of them. We fighting or going around?
translations.TL: Ang dami nila. Lalaban ba tayo o iiwas?

translations.EN: Big swarm ahead. What's the plan?
translations.TL: Malaking kuyog sa unahan. Ano'ng plano?

translations.EN: Whole herd in our way. Do we push through or find another path?
translations.TL: Buong kawan ang nakaharang. Susugod ba tayo o maghahanap ng ibang daan?

translations.EN: Look at the street. Are we engaging or avoiding?
translations.TL: Tingnan mo ang kalsada. Lalabanan ba natin o iiwasan?

translations.EN: Infected group is large. How do you want to handle this?
translations.TL: Malaki ang grupo ng infected. Paano mo gustong harapin 'to?

translations.EN: Crowd ahead of us. Should we fight or sneak past?
translations.TL: May mga patay sa harap natin. Lalaban ba tayo o lulusot nang tahimik?

translations.EN: There's quite a crowd. What are we doing?
translations.TL: Medyo marami sila. Ano'ng gagawin natin?

translations.EN: They're blocking the lane. Do we clear them or detour?
translations.TL: Harang sila sa daan. Lilinisin ba natin o iikot tayo?

translations.EN: Horde right in front. What do you want to do?
translations.TL: Kuyog mismo sa harap. Ano'ng gusto mong gawin?

translations.EN: That's more than a few. Engage or back off?
translations.TL: Higit pa sa iilan 'yan. Susugod o aatras?

translations.EN: Take them.
translations.TL: Sugurin natin.

translations.EN: We fight. Weapons up.
translations.TL: Lalaban tayo. Itaas ang sandata.

translations.EN: Engage. Clear them all.
translations.TL: Sugod. Ubusin silang lahat.

translations.EN: Stand and fight. Don't break line.
translations.TL: Tumayo at lumaban. Huwag sirain ang linya.

translations.EN: Let's take them down right here.
translations.TL: Itumba na natin sila rito mismo.

translations.EN: Strike now. Watch each other's sides.
translations.TL: Tira na ngayon. Bantayan ang gilid ng isa't isa.

translations.EN: We're clearing this herd. Let's go.
translations.TL: Lilinisin natin ang kuyog na 'to. Tara.

translations.EN: Cut them down one by one.
translations.TL: Hiwain sila isa-isa.

translations.EN: Fight through them. Forward.
translations.TL: Lusubin natin sila. Pasulong.

translations.EN: Take the fight to them.
translations.TL: Harapin natin ang laban.

translations.EN: Go around.
translations.TL: Umikot tayo.

translations.EN: Bypass them. Stay quiet.
translations.TL: Lalagpasan natin sila. Huwag mag-ingay.

translations.EN: Find another route. Don't draw them.
translations.TL: Maghanap ng ibang ruta. Huwag silang akitin.

translations.EN: Circle wide. Keep in the shadows.
translations.TL: Umikot nang malayo. Manatili sa dilim.

translations.EN: Not worth the ammo. Move around.
translations.TL: Sayang ang bala. Umiwas na lang.

translations.EN: Detour through the alley. Quietly.
translations.TL: Daan tayo sa eskinita. Nang tahimik.

translations.EN: We sneak past. Crouch and move.
translations.TL: Lulusot tayo nang lihim. Yumuko at lumakad.

translations.EN: Leave them be. Take the back way.
translations.TL: Hayaan sila roon. Daan tayo sa likod.

translations.EN: Avoid contact. Step carefully.
translations.TL: Iwasan ang engkwentro. Mag-ingat sa bawat hakbang.

translations.EN: Back out and take the alternate street.
translations.TL: Atras muna at dumaan sa kabilang kalsada.

translations.EN: Hold for now.
translations.TL: Hinto muna.

translations.EN: Stay put. Watch their movement.
translations.TL: Diyan lang. Bantayan ang galaw nila.

translations.EN: Hold position and let them pass.
translations.TL: Hawakan ang pwesto at hayaang lumampas sila.

translations.EN: Wait here. Don't make a sound.
translations.TL: Maghintay rito. Huwag gagawa ng tunog.

translations.EN: Hold up. See which way they drift.
translations.TL: Tigil muna. Tignan kung saan sila papunta.

translations.EN: Freeze. Don't reveal our position.
translations.TL: Huwag gagalaw. Huwag ilantad ang pwesto natin.

translations.EN: Keep low and hold here.
translations.TL: Yumuko at manatili rito.

translations.EN: Stay behind cover for a moment.
translations.TL: Manatili sa kublihan sandali.

translations.EN: Hold the line. Wait for the signal.
translations.TL: Hawakan ang linya. Hintayin ang senyas.

translations.EN: Wait and observe before moving.
translations.TL: Maghintay at magmasid bago kumilos.

source.name: Project Hoomans Horde Combat Reaction Content
